scope: Formal, neutral app-facing copy; audit of BundleHTTPServer without changing the loading architecture.

bundle_transport.decision: Retained; no native transport or origin migration was requested or performed.
bundle_transport.purpose: Serves packaged H5 assets to WKWebView from the app process at http://127.0.0.1:18765. It is not the account, messaging, payment or moderation backend and is not a Vite preview server.
bundle_transport.boundary: Loopback listener, GET/HEAD only, bundle-root path validation, Host/Origin checks, MIME whitelist, audio byte ranges, bounded connections and timeouts. Loopback is not authentication; this does not claim absolute isolation from all processes on the device.
dependencies: WebViewController starts the server before loading index.html.
Navigation, native bridge, purchases and media-capture permission guards trust the existing origin.
Account metadata and IndexedDB media are origin-scoped; changing the origin requires a tested data migration rather than erasing or reseeding accounts.
bundle_transport.removal: A file URL, custom scheme or deployed HTTPS frontend could be evaluated as a separate architectural change. Direct deletion would break current references and loading. Resource resolution, modules, secure capabilities, persistence migration and native bridge trust require complete regression before a replacement can ship.

copy_changes: Canonical privacy and terms use neutral information-use, retention, permission and deletion language rather than browser/app storage mode explanations. Welcome, registration, Settings and Sheets still consume one canonical source.
Support uses Send message and Sending your message; failed delivery clearly keeps the message unsent and editable. It does not create a ticket or success response.
Login inspection errors no longer expose test-state terminology; introduction errors no longer describe internal drafts; missing coin metadata is Unavailable rather than Not recorded.
Media cleanup failures retain actionable privacy and storage instructions instead of implying successful removal.
Toast/auth presentation rejects legacy development-mode captions without replacing denial, unavailable payment, unconfirmed delivery or storage-space errors with success.
preserved: Business logic, account IDs, fixed-code validation, stored profiles, relationships, conversations, media, balances, internal local_saved/fixture identifiers and storage keys.
Theme, layouts, existing Loading durations, atomic persistence, cancellation and busy guards.
Real permission, purchase verification, unavailable delivery, reporting and human-review boundaries.
Normal product content such as Robotics Demo Day, local phrase and local emergency services is not a development-mode label.
Consent revision identifiers are unchanged for wording-only updates; no new data purpose, permission or service was added and existing consent was not silently rewritten.
Both convention files were read completely and left untouched by this task; pre-existing modifications remain.

browser.method: isolated touch-enabled Chromium, production H5 fulfilled from files, no preview server

browser_warnings.description: Existing uni statistics requests were deliberately blocked; the two retry warnings are preserved in the browser report. No application warning or page error was added.

broader_unit_suite.boundary: These files were already absent, with HostTests.swift staged for deletion. User changes were preserved, not restored or bypassed.

verification.native: Main iOS project bundled H5 updated by postbuild. No new native permission, payment, WKWebView runtime or full-app production acceptance is claimed.
verification.legal_boundary: Wording cleanup is not certification of publication readiness. No legal operator, hosting location, review service, delivery provider or cloud processing was invented.

workspace: Only task-scoped wording, regression tests and evidence were edited. Unrelated modifications and staged deletions were preserved. No git stage, commit, push, signing change, archive overwrite or data reset was performed.
